scope: active valid-CRM Kid City USA production tenant plus both active Miss Honeys; excludes demo tenants and Kid City unassigned lead queue
query: select t.slug as tenant_slug, b.name as brand, c.name, c."crmLocationId", c."agencyReconciliationEnabled", c."customFields"->>'tuitionBillingEnabled' as tuition_billing_enabled from public."Center" c join public."Organization" o on o.id=c."organizationId" join public."Brand" b on b.id=o."brandId" join public."Tenant" t on t.id=b."tenantId" where c.status='active' and ((t.slug='kid-city-usa' and c."crmLocationId" ~ '^(.+[[:space:]]+-[[:space:]]+)?[A-Za-z]{2}[[:space:]]*\|[[:space:]]*.+$') or t.slug='miss-honeys-learning-center') order by t.slug,c.name
